text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E and Stock B at gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; consider each position's role and risk in the portfolio.","I should not let my average cost or reluctance to realize a loss drive decisions; judge whether holding still makes sense from here.","Recent price moves have no predictive power, so I should avoid trading on short-term patterns and make deliberate, diversified decisions."]}
